annotations.title: Set up getting paid with Stripe

description: Set up getting paid, as the Get paid dialog's Stripe button does: makes the coach's own Stripe account if there is none and returns the link to Stripe's onboarding (their details, ID and bank account), which the coach opens themselves — it lasts a few minutes. A finished account returns the link to their Stripe Dashboard instead. country: where the coaching business is, two letters (CH, DE, GB…); needed the first time, and Stripe cannot change it later.

country.description: ISO country code of the coaching business, e.g. CH

name: start_payment_setup
